assessment: How and why nutritional requirements change over development and differ between species are important questions with wide-ranging implications across a range of disciplines, from ecology to health. In this important study, Talal and colleagues set out to address these questions in laboratory and field experiments with grasshoppers, and with comparative analyses across different species. The laboratory experiments are convincing, and the study offers evidence of a universal shift from high protein to high carbohydrate intake during ontogeny.
